conviction_note: Mildly positive. Two counterparties reported after Penguin last spoke, and both point to a memory quarter (Jun-Aug) above Penguin's own guide: Micron beat its own FQ4 guide by about 8.5% and guided FQ1 up 13% q/q, and ADATA posted record months. Penguin's Q4 guide explicitly assumed less pricing favourability than Q3. Against that, management only reiterated the ~30% FY27 framework on 2026-09-10, after the quarter had closed. The upside skew (-21.8) and a +16% 20-day run-up show the market already leans the same way, and the FY27 bar is unsourced. So p_up is 55 on a 16% absolute move, giving +1.6. The findings sum to +2.8 because each is sized on its own; the gap is the priced-in lean, which is carried in p_up.
bar: Q4 FY26 net sales consensus ~$512.5-514.5M from two roughly agreeing sources (itiger/Tiger consensus $514.45M, adj EPS $0.77; second source $512.5M / $0.61 EPS, which disagrees on EPS): https://www.itiger.com/news/1107455466. The company guide (FY26 net sales +22% +/-2% on FY25 $1,368.8M, YTD $1,164.8M) implies Q4 ~$505M (range ~$478-532M). FY26 non-GAAP EPS $2.60 +/- $0.05 implies Q4 ~$0.75. Sources: https://www.itiger.com/news/2649937949 and https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1616533/000161653325000057/pengq4-25form8xkxex991.htm. The FY27 bar is the company's preliminary ~30% sales and EPS growth from the FY26 midpoint (≈$2.17B, ≈$3.38). The sell-side FY27 consensus is unsourced, so the guidance finding is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 7.24M shares = 19.51% of float, 5.47 days to cover per equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/peng/shortinterest, September 2026 settlement, exact date not shown). Benzinga shows 12.13% of float and 5.4 DTC (https://benzinga.com/quote/PENG/short-interest, settlement date not shown). Part of the short is likely convert-arbitrage hedging after the July 2026 $650M (+$100M option) zero-coupon convertible, so the 19.5% overstates squeezable shorts. Baseline skew_25d is -21.8 vol points (upside paid), ATM IV 135%, put/call OI 0.54, run-up +16% over 20 days and +6.6% over 5 days, and spot $59.49 is 27% below the 52-week high (stock was $77.80 on 2026-07-14). The option market leans up, the same way as these findings.

findings.finding: Penguin's FQ4 (Jun-Aug 2026) memory guide explicitly 'assumes less pricing favorability than we experienced in Q3'. The implied Q4 Integrated Memory sales are ~$298-321M (+8-17% q/q). Since then Micron reported its Jun-Aug quarter at $54.23B against its own $50.0B +/-1.0B guide, about 8.5% above. ADATA, a Taiwan DRAM module maker, posted record July (+25.4% m/m) and August revenue. Integrated Memory, ~57% of sales, is therefore likely to land above the implied memory range and lift total net sales above the ~$513M bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 FY26 (2026-07-07): revenue $479M vs ~$407M consensus, a 17% beat led by memory (+111% y/y), together with a raise and a first FY27 view, and the stock rose +25.1%. Q1 FY26 (2026-01-06): memory +41% y/y but Advanced Computing -15%, and the stock fell -13.8%. On this name the reaction follows the guide more than the reported quarter.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at ~$513M sits only ~1.5% above the ~$505M guide midpoint, so the sell-side bar has not absorbed a memory beat of the size Micron's quarter implies. If it had, revenue estimates would sit near the top of the guided range (~$530M). The stock has risen +6.6% in the 5 days since Micron's 2026-09-30 print, so some of this is already in the price.
findings.independence: Micron FQ4 FY26 8-K, 2026-09-30, revenue $54.23B vs guide $50.0B +/-1.0B: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000723125/000072312526000018/a2026q4ex991-pressrelease.htm. ADATA July 2026 NT$18.38B, +25.4% m/m, chairman guiding Q3 DRAM contract +20%: https://finance.technews.tw/2026/08/06/adatas-july-revenue-increased-by-over-331-year-on-year-setting-a-new-record/. ADATA August NT$18.93B, +3.0% m/m, a record: https://finance.technews.tw/2026/09/07/adata-3260-202608-financial-report/. TrendForce 2026-07-03 had Q3 conventional DRAM contract +13-18% q/q: https://www.trendforce.com/presscenter/news/20260703-13134.html. Net of the rest of the company: Advanced Computing's implied Q4 range is wide ($114-147M, FY -15 to -20%) and lumpy, and the guide implies a non-GAAP gross margin of ~26%, so a memory beat can be partly offset there.

findings.finding: The full FY27 outlook due on this call (the preliminary view was ~+30% sales and EPS from the FY26 midpoint, set on 2026-07-07) has room to come in above 30% on memory pricing. Micron guided FQ1 FY27 revenue to $61.5B +/-1.5B (+13% q/q), and TrendForce's September report has Q4 server DIMM contract prices up more than 10% q/q. Annualising a Q4 memory run-rate of ~$320-340M alone gives ~$1.3B against ~$0.9B in FY26. The upside is tempered because management only reiterated '30%' at Goldman Sachs on 2026-09-10, after the quarter had closed, and filed no pre-announcement 8-K (it did pre-announce on 2026-06-01). Guidance is being set by an interim CFO.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On guidance prints this stock moves the most. 2025-10-07, first FY26 guide (~6% growth vs ~10% expected): -16.0%. 2026-04-01, raise: +13.4%. 2026-07-07, raise plus preliminary FY27 +30%: +25.1%.
findings.why_not_priced: The only public FY27 number is the company's own July '30%', set before the Q3 pricing upgrade and before Micron's FQ1 guide, and no Penguin-specific update has followed except the 2026-09-10 reiteration. If the market expected a guide well above 30%, the stock would be near its July level ($77.80 on 2026-07-14) rather than 27% below the high while memory peers rallied. The upside skew and the +16% run-up show part of this is anticipated. The FY27 consensus is unsourced, so this finding is capped.
findings.independence: TrendForce Server DIMM Price Sep. 2026 (Q4 contract +10%+ q/q): https://www.trendforce.com/research/download/RP260930XF. Management reiteration of 30% FY27 at Goldman Sachs Communacopia, 2026-09-10: https://quartr.com/events/penguin-solutions-inc-peng-goldman-sachs-communacopia-technology-conference-2026_o0c9VmaL. That reiteration is the counterweight already netted into this size. This finding shares the Micron 8-K with finding 1, but on a different line (forward guide, not the reported quarter).

findings.finding: The July 2026 refinancing raised a $650M 0.00% convertible due 2031 (conversion price $116.70, capped call to $175.05), exchanged $135.5M of 2029 notes and $160.0M of 2030 notes, and repaid $100M under the credit agreement. It funds a visible working-capital ramp: Q3 receivables $704M vs $293M a year earlier, inventory $498M vs $184M, operating cash flow -$75M. It also lowers interest cost into FY27. The preliminary FY27 EPS view, given on 2026-07-07 before this deal, 'factors in the higher share count'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no prior print where financing was the surprise. The stock fell from $77.80 on 2026-07-14 (pricing day) to $59.49.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal itself is public. What is not yet visible is how the lower interest cost and the exchange of in-the-money 2029/2030 notes change FY27 EPS against the July preliminary view; that first appears in the full FY27 guide. The size is small because the coupons on the retired notes were not sourced.
findings.independence: Working-capital ramp from the Q3 prepared remarks (same company, different document): https://s204.q4cdn.com/917347554/files/doc_financials/2026/q3/PENG-Q3-FY26-Earnings-Call-Prepared-Remarks-for-posting.pdf. Use of proceeds from the 8-K exhibit 99.1: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001616533/000119312526307989/d103073dex991.htm

findings.finding: Positioning cuts both ways and is sized at zero. Short interest is 12-19.5% of float (5.4-5.5 days to cover), partly convert-arbitrage hedging, which favours a squeeze on a strong guide. Against that, calls are bid (25-delta skew -21.8, put/call OI 0.54) and the stock is +16% over 20 sessions into the print, which raises the bar for a 'reiterate 30%' outcome.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Signs have alternated across the last seven prints (+25.1, +13.4, -13.8, -16.0, +10.6, -10.3, +8.0), with a median absolute move of 13.4%.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is the price itself. It is filed so the opposing forces are recorded, not as an edge.
findings.independence: Benzinga short interest page, 12.13% of float, 5.4 days to cover: https://benzinga.com/quote/PENG/short-interest. Skew and run-up are from the sealed baseline.

baseline_tension: What I found agrees with the market. The upside skew (-21.8), the +16% 20-day run-up and the move after Micron already lean positive, so the findings are partly priced and p_up is held at 55, not higher.
lessons_applied: Lessons 1 and 9: the memory beat lands on the reported quarter, and this name pays for the guide, not the quarter (Jan 2026: memory up, stock -13.8%). Advanced Computing's wide implied range nets against it, so finding 1 went from +2.0 to +1.5.
Lesson 6: the Q4 revenue bar is sourced (company guide plus two roughly agreeing consensus figures), but the FY27 bar is not, so the guidance finding is capped: +1.5 to +1.0.
Lesson 4: the financing was checked against what the money buys (a corroborated working-capital ramp), so it is positive or zero. The EPS effect is inference with unsourced coupons: +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 7: the sign agrees with a large upside skew, so p_up stays at 55. The positioning finding stays at 0 because the short (part convert hedge) and the call demand offset.
abs_move_pct (16) and p_up (55) unchanged: the lessons moved finding sizes only, not the scaled measurement.
